audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Karma in both layers while whys[4] on that exact row says 'he wins the all-in here'. Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and first item were given to Tryndamere or Skill while their whys describe Karma bullying him.
audit.why: The row that matters most is 6: Undying Rage is his single power spike and the chart credited it to Karma. The packet chart matches every why word for word.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Karma / Karma / Karma / Tryndamere / Karma / Tryndamere in both layers, with the full-layer whys on rows 1, 2 and 4 rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY at 7/10 against a 61.9% win rate over 42 games.
audit.why: This is one of Karma's better lanes — she out-ranges him 950 to 650 for the whole early game and his only spike is a 120s ultimate.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED, diffRating 4/10, Tryndamere carry threat 7/10 (he still carries hard if the lane goes wrong).

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout's directional slow was never mentioned anywhere, and Undying Rage was described only as 'five seconds unkillable' with no cooldown — one field even calls it something he can 'whiff'.
audit.why: Mocking Shout slows only enemies with their backs turned, so the instinctive reaction — turn and run — is exactly what lets him stick to a 675-range enchanter. Kiting sideways beats it. And Undying Rage is a self-buff on 120s at rank 1: it cannot be whiffed, and its cooldown is the real green light.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; the 'whiffs Undying Rage' line replaced with spending it early.

notes: The chart had Level 6 backwards — it credited Karma with the row whose own why says 'he wins the all-in here', on the one level where Tryndamere gains his only spike. Mocking Shout's back-turned-only slow was missing and is the most useful new fact on this page: the natural reaction of running from a diving Tryndamere is precisely what activates it. Also removed the claim that Undying Rage can be 'whiffed' — it is a self-buff, not a skillshot. No mirror existed yet for this matchup.
